member.name: T:MindAttic.Telemetry.TelemetryMaintenance
member.summary: Recovers session files an earlier run left as .ndjson.tmp because it didn't shut down cleanly (crash, force-kill, power loss). Every line already flushed to disk is still valid JSON — recovery just appends a synthetic SessionEnd record ({"recovered":true}) and renames the file, the same "every record is independently durable" property that makes the whole format crash-safe in the first place.

member.summary: Records one full rules-engine turn: the state before, the command submitted, whether it was accepted, every event it produced, and the state after. This is the generic shape every turn/event-sourced game rules engine already produces (GridGameGaiden's BattleEngine.Apply is the reference case) — pass your own serializable DTOs; the core never requires one universal event shape.
